codes.means: a markdown file in the workflows folder has no YAML header, so it is no map and cannot name its standard
codes.fix: write the header from map-a-workflow's template (its new-map writes one), or move the file out of the workflows folder

codes.means: the map names no standard, the bare unversioned hdsop URL written before versions, or another kind's standard
codes.fix: hdsop-md stamp <workflows-dir> --apply adds or upgrades it; a record naming another kind's standard is not a map, so move or fix it by hand

codes.means: the map names a version of the hdsop standard this validator does not implement
codes.fix: install the hdsop-md version that implements it, or rewrite the map to https://hypercontext.wiki/standards/hdsop/v1

codes.means: the header has no title or an empty one; with none, Supersuit's catalog does not count the file as a map and never scores it
codes.fix: set title to the workflow's name

codes.means: the header carries a key the workflow schema does not define (kind: included)
codes.fix: remove the key, or move what it says into the body under a heading

codes.means: a value is the wrong shape: a nested map, a list where one value belongs, or one value where a list belongs
codes.fix: write lists as [a, b] or one item per line, every other key as a single value

codes.means: a single value spans lines or runs past 400 characters
codes.fix: keep it to one line; a paragraph belongs in the body under a heading

codes.means: doc_status is not unmapped, drafting or proven
codes.fix: set doc_status to unmapped, drafting or proven

codes.means: updated is not a real YYYY-MM-DD date, or last_run is neither a real date nor never
codes.fix: write the date as YYYY-MM-DD; last_run may also be never

codes.means: two maps in the folder claim the same HDSOP id
codes.fix: give one of them the next free id in its domain (map-a-workflow's new-map allocates one)

codes.means: a map has no row in CATALOG.md, so it is written and never scored
codes.fix: add a row for it to the catalog (map-a-workflow's catalog.mjs add, then set --map)
